text:
Irish boxer Lee Reeves dies aged 31 three months after suffering serious injuries in fight
Lee Reeves underwent surgery after he was knocked out by Gary Cully in August; Limerick native was in medically induced coma until his death following infection; 'Everyone is devastated to learn of the passing of Lee Reeves,’ said promoter Queensberry
Tuesday 17 November 2026 08:15, UK
Irish boxer Lee Reeves has died at the age of 31, three months after suffering serious injuries during a fight.
Local media reports in Reeves' hometown of Limerick said he underwent surgery after his knockout loss to Gary Cully in a junior welterweight bout in August in Dublin and had been in a medically induced coma since.
The reports added that he had contracted an infection over the weekend which led to his death on Monday.
"Everyone at Queensberry is devastated to learn of the passing of Lee Reeves," the promoters said in a statement. "Lee was an immensely talented boxer, as well as a true role model and inspiration to his community."
Cully described Reeves as "a character and a gent".
"It's never been nothing love between us champ, can't really believe I'm writing this but RIP brother," he wrote on social media.
Reeves won 16 of his 18 professional bouts, including 11 by knockout.
Jonathan O'Brien, a former coach of Reeves, posted on social media: "Goodbye son, sleep tight, you fought so hard until the end. We love you so much."
Reeves' sister Jessie also paid tribute: "I'll see you on the other side my brother. I've no words for this. I love you endlessly El Champo."
digest_he: המתאגרף האירי לי ריבס מת בגיל 31, שלושה חודשים לאחר שספג פציעות קשות במהלך קרב. דיווחים מקומיים בעיר הולדתו לימריק ציינו כי הוא עבר ניתוח לאחר שהפסיד בנוקאאוט לגארי קולי בקרב במשקל חצי-בינוני באוגוסט בדבלין, ומאז היה תרדמת מורדמת רפואית. הדיווחים הוסיפו כי הוא נדבק בזיהום במהלך סוף השבוע שהוביל למותו ביום שני. גורמים בעולם האגרוף ומשפחתו ספדו לו ותיארו אותו כספורטאי מוכשר ומודל לחיקוי.
